transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?

translations.en.sahih: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
translations.en.pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
translations.en.yusufali: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah orang yang menghardik anak yatim,

transliteration: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

translations.en.sahih: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
translations.en.pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
translations.en.yusufali: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
translations.id.indonesian: dan tidak menganjurkan memberi makan orang miskin.

translations.en.sahih: So woe to those who pray
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kecelakaanlah bagi orang-orang yang shalat,

translations.en.sahih: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
translations.en.pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer;
translations.en.yusufali: Who are neglectful of their prayers,

translations.en.sahih: Those who make show [of their deeds]
translations.en.yusufali: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
